volunteering.description: I had the privilege of representing Monash Business School at Open Day 2024. I ran the Business Analytics stall at Monash University's largest campus. I connected with hundreds of prospective students, sharing insights about the field. I helped prospective students navigate their academic and career futures.

volunteering.role: Undergraduate Student Representative, Department Education Committee (M+AE)
volunteering.description: I was nominated and chosen as the Undergraduate Representative on the Department Education Committee (M+AE) at Monash University in June 2023. I advocate for the interests and perspectives of undergraduate students in M+AE units. I attend committee meetings and actively contribute to discussions on learning and teaching matters. I serve as a vital link between students and the Committee, ensuring their voices are heard. I raise topics of concern or interest to help enhance the educational experience. I am committed to fostering an environment that prioritizes student engagement and addresses educational needs.
I participated in a TOM Makeathon to help Joan, creating assistive technology solutions for people living with disabilities. This is an experience I will forever cherish.

I actively volunteered in Scouts, helping raise funds and spending weekends planting trees. I also played an active role in organizing his Venture unit's annual formal, raising money for charities such as BeyondBlue and Autism Australia.
I volunteered at Rosies in Year 12, operating a tea & coffee van offering support and companionship to the homeless in Melbourne CBD.
I volunteered at Glenallen School, assisting students and staff, particularly in preparing for an event by creating brochures with student artworks.
I organized a doughnut stall with friends to raise money for an orphanage in China as part of my high school's Mission Action Day.
I participated in door knocking with a friend to raise money for the Australian Red Cross in Mulgrave.

reviews.review: Jason was a valuable member of our team over his 5 months as an intern at Tesla. He consistently went above and beyond what was expected of him as an engineer, taking on additional roles working with suppliers to make sure we got parts on time and for the right time. He consistently took initiative and developed interesting designs with useful feedback. He was also a very pleasant presence in the office every day, with lots of energy and enthusiasm in all of his work.

Jason is a first principles based engineer who dives into the details to determine the best solution to novel design problems. He works well cross-functionally with design, supply chain, manufacturing and quality organizations where he presents data in a concise manner to bring his designs to production.
Jason is very knowledgeable and proficient at explaining complex topics as well as being friendly and approachable. He is an exemplary TA and greatly contributed to my enjoyment of the unit.
Jason was quick to help us with everything and was constantly reassuring us and giving us constructive and positive feedback not just as a team, but individually as well.
Great!! Was really helpful and guided us through every assessment.
